summary.en: Choose branches and trace loops, enhanced for, switch expressions and labelled exits.
summary.bn: শর্ত, লুপ, enhanced for, switch expression আর লেবেলসহ break ব্যবহার করুন।

notes: Enhanced for dates from Java 5; switch expressions require Java 14 or later.

sections.title: Trace the check, body and update
Empty work, boundaries and nested exits
Choose the clearest route for the task

examples.title: A grade boundary
examples.explanationHtml: The comparison includes 80, so the first branch prints A+.

examples.title: Loop and enhanced for totals
examples.explanationHtml: score receives each array value. Adding 12, 8 and 10 produces 30.

examples.title: A switch expression
examples.explanationHtml: The matching arrow arm supplies Weekend. The semicolon ends the assignment containing the expression.

examples.title: Leaving two search loops
examples.explanationHtml: The match is at row 1, column 0. break search exits the outer labelled loop too.

examples.title: A loop that runs before checking
examples.explanationHtml: The do body runs once before its false condition is tested, leaving count equal to 1.

practice.title: Pass or retry
practice.statementHtml: Input: a mark from 0 to 100. Print Pass for marks at least 40; otherwise print Retry.
hints: Include the boundary in the pass branch.

practice.title: Count even rolls
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 1000. Print the number of even integers from 1 through n.
hints: Let an empty range leave the counter at zero.

practice.title: Attendance sum
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 50, followed by n attendance counts from 0 to 30. Store the values in an int array, then total them with enhanced for. Print the total.
hints: Use an indexed loop to fill the array and enhanced for to read it.

practice.title: First occupied seat
practice.statementHtml: Input: rows and columns from 1 to 5, then a rectangular grid of zeros and ones. Read the full grid. Print the zero-based row and column of the first 1 in row order, or -1 -1.
hints: Label the search loop, not the input loop.

practice.title: Day label
practice.statementHtml: Input: day from 1 to 7. Use a switch expression to print Weekend for 5 or 6, otherwise Class day.
hints: The default arm supplies the remaining value.

quiz.prompt: How many times does this while body increase count?
quiz.explanation: The loop runs for starting counts 0, 1 and 2, then stops at 3.

quiz.prompt: Does assigning to the enhanced-for variable replace array elements?
quiz.explanation: mark is a local copy of each primitive element. Assigning it does not write into the array.

quiz.prompt: Which switch arm supplies the fee for code 2?
quiz.explanation: The second arm yields 200 with no fall-through.

quiz.prompt: Which condition can be used directly in Java if?
quiz.explanation: A comparison produces boolean. An int expression is not a condition in Java.

quiz.prompt: When does a do-while test its condition?
quiz.explanation: A do body executes at least once, even when the first check is false.

quiz.prompt: What does an unlabelled break leave in nested loops?
options: The innermost enclosing loop or switch
quiz.explanation: A plain break affects the nearest eligible construct. A label can name an outer target.

quiz.prompt: Which release made switch expressions a permanent feature?
quiz.explanation: Switch expressions became final in Java 14 after earlier preview releases.

quiz.prompt: How does a block arm of a switch expression supply its result?
quiz.explanation: yield supplies the switch expression value from a block arm.

quiz.prompt: When is an indexed for clearer than enhanced for?
options: When you must replace elements by position
When you only need a sum
When the array has zero length
quiz.explanation: An index lets you write array[i]. Enhanced for suits reading each element.

quiz.prompt: What does continue do in a normal for loop?
options: Skip to the update and next condition check
quiz.explanation: The update still runs after continue in a for loop.

quiz.prompt: Where does break search continue execution after leaving the labelled loop?
options: At the first statement of main
At the statement after that outer loop
quiz.explanation: A labelled break exits its target statement; it does not return from the method.

quiz.prompt: Which range has no iterations in for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)?
quiz.explanation: With zero, the first condition 0 < 0 is false, so the body never runs.

keyPoints.en: Java if and loop conditions require boolean expressions.
keyPoints.bn: জাভার if আর লুপের শর্ত boolean হতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: An enhanced for loop visits array elements in order.
keyPoints.bn: enhanced for অ্যারের উপাদানগুলো ক্রমানুসারে পড়ে।

keyPoints.en: Arrow switch cases do not fall through.
keyPoints.bn: তীরচিহ্নের switch case থেকে পরের case-এ চলে যায় না।

keyPoints.en: A switch expression produces a value.
keyPoints.bn: switch expression একটি মান ফেরত দেয়।

keyPoints.en: A labelled break can leave an enclosing loop.
keyPoints.bn: লেবেলসহ break বাইরের নির্দিষ্ট লুপ থেকেও বের হতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: Explain why assigning x = 0 inside for (int x : values) does not clear an int array.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The loop variable receives a copy of each int. Updating that copy leaves the array unchanged. Use values[i] = 0 in an indexed loop.

examQuestions.question: Describe a search that leaves two nested loops on the first match.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Place a label before the outer search loop. Save the matching row and column inside the inner loop, then use break followed by the label. Initialise the saved positions to -1 for no match.

examQuestions.question: Compare an arrow switch statement with a switch expression.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Arrow arms do not fall through in either form. A switch expression must produce a value on every path. A statement performs actions without needing a resulting value.
